args.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love how clean and simple the design is — it gets straight to the point. That said, the site is quite minimal at the moment. You might consider adding a bit more about yourself, such as your background, interests, projects, or a photo, to give visitors a better sense of who you are. A little more content could really make your personal site shine. Keep up the good work!

Hi Eve! I just checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. It's great to see that you're passionate about hiking — that's a wonderful hobby to build a blog around! I'd love to see more content on your site, like trail reviews, hiking tips, photos from your adventures, or gear recommendations. Adding more posts would really help your blog connect with fellow hiking enthusiasts. Looking forward to seeing where you take it!
